summary_for_children: Surah Nuh tells how Nuh called his people for a very long time, by day and by night, telling them to ask Allah's forgiveness so He would send rain, gardens and rivers.
world_title: Nuh's Call by Night and Day
environment_concept: A village where a call goes out by night and day, in public and in private, offering showers of rain, gardens and rivers to those who seek forgiveness; the idols' names stand as empty stones.
architecture_and_scenery: A village square, private courtyards, rain clouds over gardens and rivers, and a row of nameless standing stones.

areas.name: Seven Heavens and Lamp
areas.description: A sun like a lamp and a reflecting moon.
